0022600085.text: The Orlando Magic open their 2026-27 season at home against the Atlanta Hawks, and neither team has played a game yet this season. Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery) and Noah Penda (hamstring), with Anthony Black, Franz Wagner, Jase Richardson and Jonathan Isaac listed as day-to-day with ankle, shoulder, back and knee issues, respectively. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), and Mouhamed Gueye is day-to-day with a foot fracture. The Magic lost all four meetings with the Hawks in 2025-26, including a 130-101 loss in Orlando on April 1, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Orlando a 55% chance to win.
